about: Mr. Submarine calls itself Chicago's original submarine franchise, building subs since 1975 from fresh-sliced vegetables, meats and cheese on fresh-baked bread. The Bellwood store at Mannheim and Butterfield has a drive-thru, offers delivery, and stays open late every night.
tagline: Chicago's original sub shop, with a drive-thru open late.
hours: Mon–Thu 9 AM–2 AM; Fri & Sat 9 AM–3 AM; Sunday 10 AM–2 AM (mrsubmarine.com/bellwood store page). Note: the 2018 Bellwood menu PDF lists later closes (Mon–Thu 9 AM–3 AM, Fri–Sat 9 AM–4 AM, Sun 10 AM–3 AM).
notes: Bellwood store confirmed in the chain's own locator: 4019 Butterfield Rd (Mannheim & Butterfield), (708) 544-1007, Drive Thru / Online Ordering / Delivery; menu PDF also lists (708) 544-1008. Hours conflict with trail data (trail has 10 AM–9/10 PM; official store page says open until 2–3 AM daily) — trail schedule should be updated. Trail signature 'Italian Sub', 'Steak Sub', 'Turkey Sub' are not exact menu names (menu: Mr. Sub, Steak Burger, Turkey Breast, Philly Steak). All photos are chain brand photography (menu shots and 50th-anniversary commercial stills), not the Bellwood store specifically. No suitable atmosphere photo: interior stills are from commercials with actors at an unidentified store.
